note: props carries three groups and nothing picked by hand: config is the configuration the run was started from without its transport section; reported is every profile and scalar every run reports, finite, that comes out the same across the transport models of every baseline, with the three radial grids; transport is every transport coefficient profile every run reports. The temperatures, the density and whatever the simulator computes from them move with the plasma and are never in props. rho, rho_face, volume, n_i_over_n_e and rho_ped_top under truth are what the scorer reads a prediction with. P_fusion is integrated from the predicted profiles with the Bosch-Hale reactivity for every submission. sign_LTi, sign_LTe and sign_Lne are the sign of the response of chi_i, chi_e and D_e to a step of a/L_Ti, a/L_Te and a/L_ne at every face, read from the setting's transport model on the recorded profiles, and sign_faces marks the faces between the axis and the pedestal top where the criteria read them.
